title: Introduce long-term memory and active-reply request decoration boundaries
description: AstrBot long-term memory keeps per-session chat transcripts, optional image captioning, active-reply policy, and LLM request mutation in one builtin star. Rust should isolate memory storage, active-reply decisions, image-caption provider calls, and agent request decoration before main-agent parity grows.

files.change: Define session transcript records, retention policy, active-reply policy, and image-caption request ports.
Inject memory context through AgentRunner request decoration instead of ProcessStage or provider adapters.
Persist or mock per-session memory records behind storage traits.

criteria: Active-reply probability and whitelist policy can be tested without a platform adapter.
Image captioning depends on a provider port, not a concrete provider manager.
Memory prompt injection is an agent decorator and does not mutate provider adapters directly.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-agent && cargo test -p astrbot-pipeline && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
